newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 19 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 19 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 19 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Maricopa County Community College, Ariz., $124.25 million general obligations bonds.
--Burlingame School District, Calif., $6 million school district bonds.
--Martin County, Fla., $7.7 million GOs, under the alternate bid program.
--Aurora, Ill., $8 million waterworks bonds, by direct purchase.
--Lake County, Ill., $1.25 million water bonds, by direct purchase.
--Haddon Heights Board of Education, N.J., $2.335 million school bonds.
--Carson City, Nev., $15 million public safty GOs.
